title: Comfortable Older Condo
description:
Neelys Bend Condominiums 

An older, very comfortable 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath 2 story condo. 25 mins from downtown Nashville, 20 mins from the airport.  Close to restaurants and shopping.

COVID-19 Statement:
As your host, I work hard to ensure your safety by expanding my cleaning and disinfecting protocols for the condo based on recommendations from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

The space
You are free to use the entire condo.  This is a residential condo community in a mature and quiet area next to schools.  Free parking, two designated spots.

Self check-in with lockbox.

This unit is not suited for children. 

This is a non-smoking residential unit.
